svg.title: NLP Text Summarization System Architecture
svg.desc: Two parallel pipelines — extractive (blue) and abstractive (coral) — feeding into a ROUGE evaluator (teal).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the input article look like?')
sendPrompt('How does NLTK sentence tokenization work?')
sendPrompt('How does TF-IDF scoring rank sentences?')
sendPrompt('How are TF-IDF and embedding scores combined?')
sendPrompt('How does Top-K sentence selection work?')
sendPrompt('What does an extractive summary look like?')
sendPrompt('How does the BART encoder use bidirectional attention?')
sendPrompt('How does beam search decoding work in BART?')
sendPrompt('What does detokenization do after beam search?')
sendPrompt('How does an abstractive summary differ from extractive?')
sendPrompt('How do ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L differ?')
